nodes.label: CPUCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The CPU clock (CPUCLK) is used as the operating clock of the CPU. 
Maximum frequency is 480MHz (For BGA 224 package)/400MHz (For LQFP 144/176 package)/360MHz (For LQFP 100 package).

nodes.label: ICLK
nodes.tooltip:
The system clock (ICLK) is used as the operating clock of the DMAC, DTC, Flash, SRAM, Standby SRAM, System BUS, I/O ports and ICU. 
Maximum frequency is 240 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKA
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock A (PCLKA) is used as the operating clock for the ETHERC, EDMAC, USBHS, SCI, I3C, CANFD, CNECC, SPI, CRC, DOC, ADC12, DAC12, RSIP-E51A, GPT, DOTF AES clock and CEU bus. 
Maximum frequency is 120 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKB
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock B (PCLKB) is used as the operating clock for the CAC, ELC, POEG, RTC, WDT, IWDT, AGT, ULPT, IIC, USBFS, SSIE, SDHI, TSN, ACMPHS, OSPI and DOTF bus clock. 
Maximum frequency is 60 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKC
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock C (PCLKC) is used as the operating clock for the ADC12 module. 
Maximum frequency is 60 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKD
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock D (PCLKD) is used as the operating clock for the GPT (count clock) module. 
Maximum frequency is 120 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKE
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock E (PCLKE) is used as the operating clock for the CNECC (CANFD-RAM). 
Maximum frequency is 240 MHz.

nodes.label: BCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The external bus clock (BCLK) is an operating clock for the external bus controller.
It is also output externally from the BCLK pin for the external connection bus. 
Maximum frequency is 120 MHz.

nodes.label: FCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The flash-interface clock (FCLK) is used as the operating clock for the flash-memory interfaces.
That is, FCLK is used for programming and erasure of the ROM and E2 DataFlash, and reading from the E2 DataFlash. 
Frequency must be between 4 MHz and 60 MHz when any of these features are used.

nodes.label: CLKOUT
nodes.tooltip:
Frequency output on the CLKOUT pin if CLKOUT is enabled. 
Maximum frequency is 60 MHz.

nodes.label: SCICLK
nodes.tooltip:
The SCI clock (SCICLK) is an operating clock for the SCI module. 
Maximum frequency is 120MHz.

nodes.label: SPICLK
nodes.tooltip:
The SPI clock (SPICLK) is an operating clock for the SPI module. 
Maximum frequency is 120MHz.

nodes.label: I3CCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The I3C clock (I3CCLK) is an operating clock for the I3C module. 
Maximum frequency is 200MHz.

constraints.message: The system clock source must be greater than 0.
CPUCLK must not be less than ICLK
CPUCLK must be less than or equal to 360MHz when using HOCO as source for PLL
ICLK must not be less than PCLKA or PCLKB
ICLK must not be less than FCLK
ICLK must not be less than BCLK
PCLKA must not be less than PCLKB
PCLKD must not be less than PCLKA or PCLKB
The I3CCLK frequency must meet the following constraint: I3CCLK / 2 <= PCLKA <= I3CCLK
Maximum allowed XTAL frequency for RA8M1 is 48MHz
PLL Reference Clock after divider must be between 6 and 12 MHz
PLL2 Reference Clock after divider must be between 6 and 12 MHz
If using /3, /6 or /12, other dividers cannot be /2, /4, /8, /16, /32, or /64.
